latest_release.name: v1.24.2
latest_release.body:
## v1.24.2 - 2026.11.08

### Downloads

- [macOS (Apple Silicon)](https://download.chatboxai.app/releases/Chatbox-1.24.2-arm64.dmg)
- [macOS (Intel)](https://download.chatboxai.app/releases/Chatbox-1.24.2.dmg)
- [Windows (x64)](https://download.chatboxai.app/releases/Chatbox-1.24.2-Setup.exe)
- [Linux (x64 DEB)](https://download.chatboxai.app/releases/Chatbox-1.24.2-amd64.deb)
- [Linux (ARM64 DEB)](https://download.chatboxai.app/releases/Chatbox-1.24.2-arm64.deb)

### What’s Changed

1. Improved the dark theme and mobile message layout.
2. Fixed message scrolling jumps and replies not following automatically.
3. Fixed an issue that prevented some long conversations from being restored.
4. Fixed Copilot conversation naming and other interface issues.

### 更新说明

1. 优化深色主题和移动端消息布局。
2. 修复消息滚动跳动、回复未自动跟随的问题。
3. 修复部分长对话无法恢复的问题。
4. 修复 Copilot 对话命名及其他界面问题。
